'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 Brian Hollingworth DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Hollingworth]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS14]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
